mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park and a temperature of 42 degrees. Look to the sky at 6:32 PM tonight to see the International Space Station passing from the Mount Horeb area toward the Madison direction, reaching about halfway up the sky, all under a beautiful Waxing Crescent moon.

In city news, the Plan Commission is set to discuss several new development projects on December 7, including a site plan and traffic analysis for the Sub-Zero facility in Liberty Business Park. Additionally, the Verona Municipal Court remains available to assist residents with traffic or ordinance citations.

There is plenty to do this weekend in Verona. Today, enjoy the Dane County Farmers Market or stop by Bailey's Run Vineyard and Paddy Mac's for live music. Tomorrow, head over to the Wisconsin Brewing Company for music or catch the John Denver tribute show at the Verona Area High School Fine Arts Center.

Looking at the weekly police report, on October 25, officers located a driver at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue who was arrested for a first offence O W I after being found unresponsive in his vehicle.
Make sure to stop by Culver's of Verona today to enjoy the Flavor of the Day, which is Caramel Cashew. The restaurant is currently open and will remain serving guests until 10:30 PM tonight.
